name: central-codex-adapter
transport: stdio JSONL (JSON-RPC 2.0, one frame per line)

schemaProvenance.reason: Codex CLI binary not reachable from the build sandbox (not on PATH; bundled WindowsApps shims are not executable Store stubs and probing them would risk touching personal auth/config). Spike-captured schemas used instead.
schemaProvenance.transcriptSource: spikes/codex-app-server/results/2026-11-09T02-51-04-875Z/rpc.jsonl (filtered: host paths, codexHome, installationId, serverName, OS build, disposable command text replaced with fixture placeholders)

policies.oversizeFrame: close transport, require reconciliation, never parse partial event
policies.secretHandling: logs and request errors redact token/secret/authorization material; no tokens or env in durable outbox
policies.modelMismatch: requested/observed model mismatch is a capability error, never silent fallback
